title: Effects of mTOR Inhibition With Sirolimus (RAPA) in Patients With COVID-19 to Moderate the Progression of ARDS

sections.abstract: This study assesses the clinical effectiveness of mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) inhibition with rapamycin in minimizing or decreasing the severity of acute lung injury/acute respiratory distress syndrome (ALI/ARDS) in participants infected with mild to moderate COVID-19 virus.
